_comment: Sourced commercial retail rates backing the C&I / Net-Metering offtake anchor (CI_OFFTAKE_SCORES in src/lib/scoreEngine.js). Mirrors the docs/dsire-net-billing/ on-disk-sourcing convention, but consolidated to one file because every state comes from ONE EIA table (5.6.B), not per-state program pages. Two-layer honesty: `commercial_cents_kwh` is OBSERVED (EIA, cited); `score` is Tractova's disclosed SYNTHESIS via the documented formula. scripts/audit-check.mjs fails CI when review_due passes, forcing a re-source against the then-current EIA vintage.
source: U.S. EIA Electric Power Monthly, Table 5.6.B — Average Price of Electricity to Ultimate Customers by End-Use Sector, by State (Commercial sector)
calibration: Offtake SIGNAL = clamp(round(34 + 1.8 * commercial_cents_per_kWh), 45, 72). The rate is the observed/sourced layer; the 0-100 score is Tractova's disclosed synthesis. This new cohort carries NO per-state deep-market boost (unlike some legacy hand-tuned states — e.g. TX 62 / MI 74 / FL 72, which are bumped for industrial-PPA volume or large-market depth), because these are thin / non-ISO markets where retail rate is the honest dominant offtake signal. Verified consistent against same-table legacy comparators (WA 12.01->52, OR 10.52->56, MN 11.54->55, MO 9.88->54, VA 11.52->58).

gated.AK: Commercial retail 22.38c/kWh (EIA, real) but remote / islanded with no ISO and negligible distribution-scale CS or C&I market — a high retail rate does NOT map to real offtake depth here. Deliberately left on the 55 fallback (surfaces the 'limited coverage — directional only' caption) rather than fabricate a deep-market score the rate would imply.
gated.HI: Commercial retail 37.94c/kWh (EIA, real, highest in the nation) but per-island islanded grids + a gated export structure (Smart Export per-island TOU — see the HI note in NET_BILLING_EXPORT_RATIO). Distribution-scale offtake is atypical; left on the 55 fallback rather than apply the continental rate formula.
